note: Both `realloc_oom.*ptr` fields are semantic views over the vulnerable-original source expression `p` in `mrb_realloc()`. `owned_ptr` records the caller-owned array buffer passed into the failing realloc path. `free_argument` records that same `p` only when this branch releases it through `mrb_free(mrb, p)`; the fixed instrumentation emits null because the corrected branch no longer frees `p` before raising. `gc_array_free.free_argument` is the exact array heap pointer expression later passed to `mrb_free()` at the sink.
